name: stock.haccp_export

description.en: Raw-fish freezing and traceability (P13, W-STORE). In-house: POST frozen {item, lot, hours, tempC, store?} writes a note on the stock log and answers which EU Regulation 853/2004 Annex III Section VIII rule it meets (-20C/24h or -35C/15h, else null) -- it never blocks a sale. Supplier-treated: the delivery's `treated` paper number. GET /api/owner/stock/haccp?kind=lots|orders|freezing&from=yyyy-mm-dd&to=yyyy-mm-dd (OWNER only; the venue's local days, inclusive, at most 400 days) answers text/csv derived from one replay of the stock log: lot -> orders, order -> lots (each draw's effect on the FEFO lots) and the freezing log. Integer quantities in the supply's base unit; rows recorded before records were dated have an empty date and are always included; text cells starting with = + - @ are prefixed with '. W-STORE2 (1.1.0): POST frozen also takes `started` (the venue's LOCAL time yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm, minutes; converted to UTC ms in the venue's object with its zone); with a start, `hours` may be omitted and the rule is decided by whole hours of started..now (a 20 h freeze typed as 24 h meets nothing); the answer's `hours` is the hours the rule used, `typedHours` what was sent, `started` the ms. Records without a start read as before. The freezing CSV APPENDS two columns, old positions unchanged: `by_name` (the staff member's current display name from the venue's members, resolved at export time; a removed member prints the id and an empty name, never a failed export) and `started` (venue local yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm, empty when not recorded). The Worker sends the names to the object as names=<json>. Also (operator 2026-10-05) an optional `ended` (same local text, needs `started`): the rule is then decided by started..ended, so a late record cannot inflate the hours; an end after the record is refused; the answer carries `ended` (ms or null); the freezing CSV appends an `ended` column (venue local, empty when not recorded).
description.uk: Журнал заморожування сирої риби (правила ЄС 853/2004) і CSV-експорт простежуваності партія -> замовлення, замовлення -> партії для інспектора; лише власник. 1.1.0: час початку заморожування (правило рахується від початку до кінця) і в CSV — ім'я працівника поруч з ID. Також необов'язковий кінець заморожування: правило рахується від початку до кінця, пізній запис не додає годин.
